protocol.purpose: Evaluate whether an opponent-specific defense residual adds honest directional Schedule Edge signal beyond the admitted weekly recency-only player expectation.

files.role: Prior Schedule Edge v1 policy, source identity, and fold audit; not transferable validation for this candidate.
Weekly model and admitted champion-policy identity; not Schedule Edge outcome evidence.
Standard-scoring ROS input and policy provenance only; not Schedule Edge outcome evidence.
Half-PPR ROS input and policy provenance only; not Schedule Edge outcome evidence.
Full-PPR ROS input and policy provenance only; not Schedule Edge outcome evidence.

evidenceInventory.sourceRule: The evaluator must record exact admitted source checksums and normalized row counts. Any source drift creates a new evidence identity and must be disclosed before outcomes are evaluated.
evidenceInventory.reportAvailability: Files under reports/ are local audit inputs and are not committed release artifacts; a replay must supply byte-identical files or record a new preregistered evidence identity.

historicalTraining.outcomeUse: Prior-only fitting and warm-up; no gate result.

selectionAndDevelopment.outcomeUse: Candidate selection, implementation audit, and threshold qualification. The candidate and thresholds in this document may not be tuned after this fold is opened.

retrospectiveDiagnostic.outcomeUse: One-shot retrospective diagnostic only. These outcomes were already inspected by Schedule Edge v1 and weekly/ROS development and cannot confirm or admit this v2 candidate.

prospectiveConfirmation.openAfter: The 2026 regular season is complete, final outcome sources are admitted, and every included row has a retained pre-outcome actual-opponent forecast and neutral counterfactual with matching input identities.
prospectiveConfirmation.outcomeUse: The only confirmation fold that may authorize directional labels under this protocol.

leakagePolicy.weeklyBatchLock: Every target prediction uses inputs and point-center calibration strictly before the target season/week. All games in one NFL week are locked before any target-week outcome is added.
leakagePolicy.neutralExpectation: Score the admitted laces-weekly-components-v9 recency-only strategy under the target scoring profile, including its strictly-prior walk-forward point-center calibration.
leakagePolicy.targetOutcomeUse: Evaluation only after both target forecasts are immutable.
leakagePolicy.confirmationSeal: No 2026 actual outcome may be joined, summarized, or inspected until the prospective-confirmation eligibility manifest and all paired forecast rows are checksummed and sealed.

rowComputation.neutralExpectedPoints: N_i = strictly-prior, point-center-calibrated weekly recency-only expected fantasy points for player-game i.
rowComputation.actualResidual: R_i = actual fantasy points for player-game i minus N_i.
rowComputation.clusterValue: Arithmetic mean of eligible R_i values in the cluster. A cluster, not a player row, is the evaluation sample.
rowComputation.defenseEstimate: For each target week and position, calculate each defense's mean prior cluster residual using equal game weights. Blend the current-season defense mean with the immediately prior season using four prior-season pseudo-games, then shrink it toward the matching position-wide residual mean using four defense-shrinkage games.
rowComputation.pointDifferential: The shrunk defense residual minus the matching position-wide residual mean. Positive is easier for the offense; negative is harder.
rowComputation.actualOpponentExpectedPoints: A_i = N_i plus the target opponent's strictly-prior point differential.
rowComputation.percentile: Within-position midrank percentile of the target opponent's strictly-prior shrunk defense residual; higher is easier for the offense.
rowComputation.outcomeForRankAndBuckets: The target cluster's actual residual relative to its neutral expectation.

labelRule.neutral: eligible and neither directional rule is true
labelRule.unavailable: any eligibility or support rule is false

playerRowRequirements: A unique supported position is available.
The admitted schedule identifies one target game and actual opponent.
The player belongs to the prior-only fantasy-relevant weekly backtest cohort.
The neutral recency-only expectation is finite and its input fingerprint is retained.
The actual-opponent expectation is finite and its input fingerprint is retained.
The two expectations share player, season, week, scoring-profile, source, calibration, and model-policy identities; opponent context is the only matchup-specific addition.
The defense estimate has at least six current-season strictly-prior games; prior-only labels are forbidden.
eligibility.confirmationPrecondition: Row-level actual-opponent and neutral-counterfactual forecast evidence must exist, be immutable, and have a verified checksum before any prospective-confirmation outcome is opened.
eligibility.missingDataPolicy: Missing, ambiguous, unmatched, late-generated, or non-finite rows are unavailable, never zero-filled and never treated as neutral.

metrics.rankCorrelation: Spearman correlation between cluster point differential and cluster actual residual.
metrics.bucketMeans: Arithmetic mean cluster actual residual in difficult, neutral, and favorable label buckets.
metrics.favorableMinusDifficult: Favorable bucket mean minus difficult bucket mean.
metrics.orderedSeason: difficult bucket mean < neutral bucket mean < favorable bucket mean, with every bucket nonempty.
metrics.neutralMae: Mean absolute error of neutralExpectedPoints against actual points over the same eligible player rows.
metrics.actualOpponentMae: Mean absolute error of actualOpponentExpectedPoints against actual points over the same eligible player rows.

gates.profileRule: A position must pass every gate independently under standard, half-PPR, and full-PPR scoring.
gates.foldRule: A position must pass selection/development and prospective confirmation independently. The 2025 diagnostic and any combined full-window result cannot rescue a failed admissible fold.
gates.failureRule: A null, non-finite, degenerate, missing, or below-threshold statistic fails closed. Thresholds may not be weakened after an outcome fold is inspected.

bootstrap.resampling: Within each evaluated season, sample that season's observed week blocks with replacement until the original number of observed week blocks is reached; include every eligible cluster from each sampled block, then concatenate seasons.
bootstrap.seedDerivation: Take the first eight hexadecimal characters of SHA-256(baseSeed + '|' + fold + '|' + position + '|' + scoringProfileId + '|' + metric), interpret as an unsigned 32-bit big-endian integer, and initialize mulberry32-v1.
bootstrap.quantile: R type 7 empirical quantile at probability 0.05 over the 10,000 finite replicate statistics.
bootstrap.degenerateReplicatePolicy: Any cell with fewer than 9,500 finite replicate statistics fails.

confirmationMultiplicity.family: Four positions times three scoring profiles times two metrics: rank correlation and favorable-minus-difficult spread.
confirmationMultiplicity.bootstrapPValue: (1 + number of finite replicate statistics <= 0) / (1 + number of finite replicate statistics)
confirmationMultiplicity.passRule: Each metric must have an unadjusted one-sided 95% lower bound above zero and a Holm-adjusted p-value <= 0.05. A position passes only when all six of its confirmation metric tests pass.

artifacts.promotionRule: Directional labels may be enabled only for positions listed as passing in both the immutable selection artifact and the one-shot prospective 2026 confirmation artifact under all three profiles.
artifacts.protocolChangeRule: Changing the candidate, cohort, folds, thresholds, bootstrap, multiplicity method, or evidence eligibility after inspecting an outcome creates a new protocol version and requires a new future prospective confirmation season.

execution.permittedScope: A dedicated Schedule Edge v2 evaluator may read admitted weekly/ROS inputs and write only new checksummed Schedule Edge evaluation artifacts.
forbiddenRosOperations: admit or replace a ROS champion artifact
change ROS thresholds, folds, policies, or model selection

integrity.canonicalization: UTF-8 bytes of `jq -jSc '.protocol' docs/schedule-edge-v2-preregistration-2026-09-03.json` with no trailing newline
